object_types.name: FinancialProduct
object_types.description: A financial product issued by Citic Wealth Management, including details such as registration code, product code, type, risk level, and target investors.

properties.name: registration_code
properties.description: The unique registration code assigned to the financial product in the national banking financial products registration system.

properties.name: product_code
properties.description: The internal product code used by Citic Wealth Management.

properties.name: type
properties.description: The type of the financial product, including public offering, fixed income class, and closed-end.

properties.name: risk_level
properties.description: The risk level rating assigned by Citic Wealth Management, used for reference only.

properties.name: suitable_investor_types
properties.description: The types of investors suitable for this product, such as prudent, steady, balanced, enterprising, and aggressive types.

properties.name: productCode
properties.description: The unique code assigned to the financial product.

properties.name: registrationCode
properties.description: The registration code of the financial product in the national banking wealth management information registration system.

properties.name: productName
properties.description: The name of the financial product.

properties.name: riskLevel
properties.description: The risk level rating of the financial product (PR1 to PR5).

properties.name: investmentStrategy
properties.description: Description of the investment strategy employed by the financial product.

properties.name: suitableInvestorTypes
properties.description: List of investor types suitable for this financial product based on its risk level.

properties.name: firstRedemptionDate
properties.description: The first redemption/opening date of the financial product.

properties.name: redemptionCycle
properties.description: The cycle (in days) for redemption openings after the first redemption date.

properties.name: investmentRange
properties.description: 产品允许投资的金融工具范围及比例限制。

properties.name: prohibitedInvestments
properties.description: 产品禁止投资的金融工具列表。

properties.name: investmentRestrictions
properties.description: 产品的投资限制条件，包括比例、流动性等要求。

object_types.name: Investor
object_types.description: An individual or institutional investor who purchases the financial product.

properties.name: investor_type
properties.description: The type of investor, either personal (individual) or organizational (institution).

properties.name: risk_profile
properties.description: The risk tolerance profile of the investor, such as prudent, steady, balanced, enterprising, or aggressive.

properties.name: investorId
properties.description: A unique identifier for the investor.

properties.name: investorType
properties.description: The type of investor, either 'individual' or 'institution'.

properties.name: riskProfile
properties.description: The risk tolerance profile of the investor, e.g., cautious, stable, balanced, enterprising, or aggressive.

object_types.name: FundProduct
object_types.description: A non-guaranteed, non-deposit financial product managed by Citic Wealth Management that invests and manages entrusted investor assets according to agreed investment strategies, risk-bearing and profit-sharing arrangements.

properties.name: productId
properties.description: The unique identifier code for the fund product assigned by the national banking financial management information registration system.

properties.name: productName
properties.description: The name of the fund product.

properties.name: productCode
properties.description: The code assigned to the fund product by Citic Wealth Management.

properties.name: riskLevel
properties.description: The risk level rating of the fund product, e.g., PR2 indicating a moderately low risk level suitable for stable, balanced, enterprising or aggressive investors.

properties.name: minimumHoldingPeriod
properties.description: The minimum holding period required for the fund product in natural days.

properties.name: investmentStrategy
properties.description: The investment strategy description of the fund product, including asset allocation methods and risk management approaches.

properties.name: investmentRange
properties.description: The range of assets the fund product may invest in, categorized by debt instruments, equity instruments, and commodity/financial derivative instruments with specified percentage ranges.

object_types.name: SalesChannel
object_types.description: A sales channel through which Citic Wealth Management or its authorized cooperating institutions sell fund products to investors.

properties.name: channelId
properties.description: A unique identifier for the sales channel.

properties.name: channelType
properties.description: The type of sales channel, e.g., 'direct' (Citic Wealth Management's official website or business locations) or 'cooperation' (authorized cooperating institutions).

object_types.name: RiskType
object_types.description: A type of risk associated with the fund product as disclosed in its prospectus.

properties.name: riskId
properties.description: A unique identifier for the risk type.

properties.name: riskName
properties.description: The name of the risk type, e.g., credit risk, market risk, liquidity risk, etc.

properties.name: riskDescription
properties.description: A description of the risk type and its potential impact on investors.

object_types.name: InvestorType
object_types.description: Types of investors categorized by their risk tolerance and investment profile.

properties.name: type
properties.description: The name of the investor type (e.g., Prudent, Steadfast, Balanced, Enterprising, Aggressive).

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of the characteristics and risk tolerance of this investor type.

object_types.name: RiskLevel
object_types.description: Defines the risk levels (PR1 to PR5) associated with financial products and maps them to suitable investor types.

properties.name: level
properties.description: The risk level identifier (e.g., PR1, PR2, PR3, PR4, PR5).

properties.name: riskDegree
properties.description: Description of the risk degree associated with this level (e.g., Low, Medium Low, Medium, Medium High, High).

properties.name: suitableInvestorTypes
properties.description: List of investor types suitable for financial products at this risk level.

object_types.name: InvestmentInstrument
object_types.description: 金融工具类型，如债券、股票、同业存单等。

properties.name: instrumentType
properties.description: 金融工具的类型名称。

properties.name: issuer
properties.description: 发行机构名称。

properties.name: creditRating
properties.description: 信用评级，如AAA、AA+等。

properties.name: maturityDate
properties.description: 到期日。

link_types.name: InvestsIn
link_types.description: Represents the investment relationship where an Investor invests in a FinancialProduct.

link_types.name: investsIn
link_types.description: Links a FundProduct to the RiskType objects representing the risks disclosed for that product.

link_types.name: purchases
link_types.description: Links an Investor to the FundProducts they have purchased through a SalesChannel.

link_types.name: sellsThrough
link_types.description: Links a FundProduct to the SalesChannels through which it is sold to investors.

link_types.name: ProductToRiskLevelLink
link_types.description: Links a FinancialProduct to its associated RiskLevel, indicating the product's risk rating.

link_types.name: RiskLevelToInvestorTypeLink
link_types.description: Links a RiskLevel to the InvestorTypes it is suitable for, based on risk tolerance.

link_types.name: ProductInvestsInInstrument
link_types.description: 表示金融产品投资于某个金融工具的关系。

action_types.name: Redeem
action_types.description: Allows an Investor to redeem their investment in a FinancialProduct before the maturity date, subject to conditions.

action_types.name: purchase
action_types.description: An action where an Investor purchases a FundProduct through a SalesChannel.

action_types.name: redeem
action_types.description: An action where an Investor redeems (sells back) their holdings in a FundProduct, subject to the product's minimum holding period and liquidity conditions.

action_types.name: RedeemProduct
action_types.description: Action to redeem (sell back) units of a FinancialProduct by an Investor.

action_types.name: PurchaseProduct
action_types.description: Action to purchase units of a FinancialProduct by an Investor.

action_types.name: AdjustInvestmentRange
action_types.description: 根据监管政策或市场情况调整产品的投资范围。
